questions.tier_name: Tier 1 (18%): Deterministic Parameterized SQL via MCP Toolbox
questions.question: Which active opportunities are stalled in Stage 3 (Solutioning) for more than 90 days, ordered by Total Contract Value (TCV) and showing days since last stage progression?
kpis: Stalled_TCV_At_Risk = SUM(IF(stage_name = 'Stage 3 - Solutioning' AND stage_age_days > 90, tcv_usd, 0))
questions.diagnosis: 100% deterministic filter, projection, and sort over canonical pipeline columns. Ideal for MCP Toolbox parameterized SQL (`get_stalled_stage_opportunities`) with zero LLM SQL hallucination risk.
questions.recommended_architecture: Route directly through Google MCP Toolbox (`genai-toolbox`) bound to `v_gold_opportunity_spine` in BigQuery.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT opp_id, account_name, region, industry, tcv_usd, acv_usd, stage_age_days, win_prob, deal_owner, markov_regime
FROM opportunities
WHERE stage_name LIKE 'Stage 3%' AND stage_age_days >= :min_days
ORDER BY tcv_usd DESC;
questions.sample_tools_yaml:
get_stalled_stage_opportunities:
    kind: bigquery-sql
    source: enterprise-commercial-bq
    description: Fetch opportunities stalled in a pipeline stage beyond a threshold of days.
    parameters:
      - name: min_days
        type: integer
        description: Minimum days stalled in stage (default 90).
missing_artifacts: Physical BigQuery DDL for CRM_Opportunity_Spine stage history audit table (to verify whether Stage 3 re-entry resets stage_entry_date).

questions.tier_name: Tier 1 (18%): Deterministic Parameterized SQL via MCP Toolbox
questions.question: Show our regional pipeline TCV, average win probability, and weighted bookings across North America, EMEA, APAC, and Latin America.
questions.diagnosis: Deterministic regional aggregation over verified Gold Spine measures. Requires no external APIs or stochastic simulation.
questions.recommended_architecture: Execute parameterized MCP Toolbox tool `get_regional_win_rate_trends` against `v_gold_opportunity_spine`.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT region,
       COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
       ROUND(SUM(tcv_usd) / 1e6, 2) AS total_tcv_millions,
       ROUND(AVG(win_prob) * 100, 1) AS avg_win_prob_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(tcv_usd * win_prob) / 1e6, 2) AS weighted_tcv_millions,
       ROUND(AVG(adjusted_yield_v4) * 100, 1) AS avg_adj_yield_pct
FROM opportunities
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY total_tcv_millions DESC;
questions.sample_tools_yaml:
get_regional_win_rate_trends:
    kind: bigquery-sql
    source: enterprise-commercial-bq
    description: Aggregate TCV, weighted bookings, and win rates by geographic region.

questions.tier_name: Tier 1 (18%): Deterministic Parameterized SQL via MCP Toolbox
questions.question: Which opportunities have had zero deal owner activity or CRM update for more than 14 days prior to the current snapshot?
questions.diagnosis: Deterministic date-diff hygiene check on opportunity audit timestamps.
questions.recommended_architecture: Invoke MCP Toolbox `get_stale_owner_opportunities` and surface hygiene alerts.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT opp_id, account_name, stage_name, deal_owner,
       last_owner_activity_date,
       CAST(julianday('2026-10-13') - julianday(last_owner_activity_date) AS INTEGER) AS inactive_days,
       ROUND(tcv_usd / 1e6, 2) AS tcv_millions
FROM opportunities
WHERE julianday('2026-10-13') - julianday(last_owner_activity_date) >= 14
ORDER BY inactive_days DESC;

questions.tier_name: Tier 2 (30%): Semantic Layer (Dataplex KC DAX Formulas) + Pre-Computed Gold Views + Counterfactual Simulator
questions.question: Calculate Adjusted Yield v1, v3, and v4 across our deal portfolio after stripping pass-through cloud/hardware costs, trimming top/bottom 5% outliers, and capping standard deviation sensitivity at 1.5 sigma.
questions.db_only_verdict: PARTIAL - Requires Semantic DAX + Gold View
questions.diagnosis: Raw LLM Text-to-SQL fails because 'Adjusted Yield v4' is a multi-stage proprietary DAX formula with pass-through deduction and 1.5-sigma clipping that does not exist as a raw column in the 15TB ODS.
questions.recommended_architecture: Materialize the v1/v3/v4 DAX formulas inside BigQuery Gold View `v_gold_adjusted_yield_dax` and register business glossary lineage in Dataplex Knowledge Catalog.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT p.opp_id, o.account_name, o.industry,
       ROUND(p.tcv_usd / 1e6, 2) AS tcv_m,
       ROUND(p.passthrough_cost_usd / 1e6, 2) AS passthrough_m,
       ROUND(p.gross_yield_v1 * 100, 1) AS gross_yield_v1_pct,
       ROUND(p.adjusted_yield_v3_trimmed * 100, 1) AS adj_yield_v3_trimmed_pct,
       ROUND(p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped * 100, 1) AS adj_yield_v4_sigma_pct,
       p.sigma_zscore
FROM pricing_scenarios p
JOIN opportunities o ON p.opp_id = o.opp_id
ORDER BY p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped ASC;
questions.sample_tools_yaml:
get_adjusted_yield_dax_metrics:
    kind: bigquery-sql
    source: enterprise-commercial-bq
    description: Query materialized Adjusted Yield v1/v3/v4 DAX metrics from Gold View.
missing_artifacts: Exact semantic DAX formula sheet for Adjusted Yield v1/v3/v4 (specifically pass-through cloud/hardware cost GL account codes).
Confirm whether 1.5-sigma clipping is partitioned by Industry Vertical or Global Region.

questions.tier_name: Tier 2 (30%): Semantic Layer (Dataplex KC DAX Formulas) + Pre-Computed Gold Views + Counterfactual Simulator
questions.question: If we systematically exit or re-price the bottom 20% lowest-yielding deals in our pipeline, what is the counterfactual impact on blended portfolio margin, total revenue retained, and freed-up delivery capacity?
kpis: Post_Cull_Blended_Yield = SUM(Net_Margin_USD WHERE Yield_Percentile > 0.20) / SUM(Net_Service_Rev_USD WHERE Yield_Percentile > 0.20)
questions.diagnosis: Static SQL only reports historical state. Answering 'what if we exit the bottom X% or reprice to floor Y%' requires a parameterized percentile-cull and elasticity simulator.
questions.recommended_architecture: Combine MCP Toolbox Gold View query (`simulate_portfolio_margin_cull`) with the Python Counterfactual Monte Carlo Engine.
questions.sample_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT o.opp_id, o.account_name, p.tcv_usd, p.net_service_rev_usd,
         p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped AS adj_yield,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped ASC) AS yield_pct_rank
  FROM pricing_scenarios p
  JOIN opportunities o ON p.opp_id = o.opp_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(adj_yield) * 100, 2) AS baseline_avg_yield_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN yield_pct_rank >= 0.20 THEN adj_yield END) * 100, 2) AS post_exit_avg_yield_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN yield_pct_rank < 0.20 THEN tcv_usd ELSE 0 END) / 1e6, 2) AS exited_tcv_millions,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN yield_pct_rank >= 0.20 THEN tcv_usd ELSE 0 END) / 1e6, 2) AS retained_tcv_millions
FROM ranked;
questions.sample_tools_yaml:
simulate_portfolio_margin_cull:
    kind: bigquery-sql
    source: enterprise-commercial-bq
    description: Simulate blended margin uplift when pruning bottom N% yield deals.
missing_artifacts: Counterfactual customer churn elasticity curve when repricing bottom-decile deals by +300 bps.
Stranded bench cost absorption parameters in Workforce_Skills_Graph.

questions.tier_name: Tier 2 (30%): Semantic Layer (Dataplex KC DAX Formulas) + Pre-Computed Gold Views + Counterfactual Simulator
questions.question: Classify all active accounts into Hidden Markov Pricing Regimes (High-Velocity Expansion, Margin Compression, or Stalled Procurement) and show transition probabilities when discount concessions exceed 15%.
kpis: Markov_Regime_State = ARGMAX_s P(S_t = s | Yield_Delta, Stage_Velocity, Giveaway_Pct)
flags: Missing ML / Econometric Model in DB
questions.db_only_verdict: PARTIAL - Requires Semantic DAX + Gold View
questions.diagnosis: A relational database does not natively run Hidden Markov Baum-Welch / Viterbi state estimation at query time unless pre-materialized by BQML or a Python econometric pipeline.
questions.recommended_architecture: Pre-compute Markov state probabilities in BigQuery ML / Python job into `v_gold_markov_regime_states` and expose transition shocks in the Tier-2 Simulator.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT o.markov_regime,
       COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
       ROUND(SUM(o.tcv_usd) / 1e6, 2) AS regime_tcv_millions,
       ROUND(AVG(p.discount_giveaway_pct) * 100, 1) AS avg_giveaway_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped) * 100, 1) AS avg_adj_yield_pct
FROM opportunities o
JOIN pricing_scenarios p ON o.opp_id = p.opp_id
GROUP BY o.markov_regime
ORDER BY regime_tcv_millions DESC;
questions.sample_tools_yaml:
get_markov_regime_distribution:
    kind: bigquery-sql
    source: enterprise-commercial-bq
    description: Retrieve Hidden Markov commercial regime states and giveaway averages.
missing_artifacts: Trained Hidden Markov Model (Baum-Welch transition matrix & emission probability weights) not currently persisted in BigQuery.
Historical 8-quarter pricing version sequence log in Deal_Pricing_Engine.

questions.tier_name: Tier 2 (30%): Semantic Layer (Dataplex KC DAX Formulas) + Pre-Computed Gold Views + Counterfactual Simulator
questions.question: Decompose deal win probability across the 6 commercial levers (Price Competitiveness, Executive Sponsor Alignment, Technical Differentiation, Delivery Track Record, Contracting Speed, and Partner Co-Sell) and simulate a +10% improvement in Price Competitiveness.
kpis: Logit_Win_Prob = 1 / (1 + EXP(-(b0 + b1*Price_Score + b2*Sponsor_Alignment + b3*Delivery_SLA + b4*Stage_Velocity)))
flags: Missing ML / Econometric Model in DB
questions.diagnosis: Calculating marginal win-rate elasticity across 6 interacting levers requires logistic regression coefficients stored in the Gold View plus an interactive perturbation engine.
questions.recommended_architecture: Query baseline lever scores via MCP Toolbox `get_deal_win_lever_elasticity` and run the 6-Lever Logit Perturbation Simulator in the agent tier.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT o.opp_id, o.account_name,
       ROUND(o.tcv_usd / 1e6, 2) AS tcv_m,
       ROUND(o.win_prob * 100, 1) AS baseline_win_prob_pct,
       ROUND(o.client_Temp_score * 100, 1) AS sponsor_alignment_score,
       ROUND(p.price_competitiveness_score * 100, 1) AS price_competitiveness_score,
       ROUND(MIN(0.96, o.win_prob + 0.085 * (1 - o.win_prob)) * 100, 1) AS simulated_win_prob_plus10_price_pct
FROM opportunities o
JOIN pricing_scenarios p ON o.opp_id = p.opp_id
ORDER BY o.tcv_usd DESC;
questions.sample_tools_yaml:
get_deal_win_lever_elasticity:
    kind: bigquery-sql
    source: enterprise-commercial-bq
    description: Fetch 6-lever deal win probability drivers and elasticity uplift.
missing_artifacts: Fitted 6-lever logistic regression feature weights (b0..b6) across won/lost deals in CRM_Opportunity_Spine.
Competitor bid spread proxy variable in Deal_Pricing_Engine.

questions.tier_name: Tier 2 (30%): Semantic Layer (Dataplex KC DAX Formulas) + Pre-Computed Gold Views + Counterfactual Simulator
questions.question: Run a downside stress test: if our single largest $510M mega-deal (OPP-9020) is lost or slips by two quarters, what happens to North America bookings coverage and blended delivery utilization?
questions.diagnosis: Requires counterfactual removal of specific mega-deal IDs and recomputation of regional target coverage and bench absorption.
questions.recommended_architecture: Execute stress-test simulation over `v_gold_opportunity_spine` comparing baseline vs. ex-OPP-9020 scenarios.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(tcv_usd * win_prob) / 1e6, 2) AS baseline_weighted_pipeline_m,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN opp_id != 'OPP-9020' THEN tcv_usd * win_prob ELSE 0 END) / 1e6, 2) AS stressed_weighted_pipeline_m,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN opp_id = 'OPP-9020' THEN tcv_usd * win_prob ELSE 0 END) / 1e6, 2) AS mega_deal_exposure_m
FROM opportunities
WHERE region = 'North America';
questions.sample_tools_yaml:

questions.question: Quantify total commercial giveaway (rate card ceiling vs. negotiated bill rate excluding pass-through expenses) across deals where discount exceeds 15%.
questions.db_only_verdict: PARTIAL - Requires Semantic DAX + Gold View
questions.diagnosis: Requires joining rate card baselines to final pricing scenarios while excluding hardware/cloud pass-through revenue.
questions.recommended_architecture: Expose via `v_gold_adjusted_yield_dax` in Dataplex Knowledge Catalog with strict semantic definition of Net Service Revenue.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT p.opp_id, o.account_name,
       p.standard_rate_usd, p.negotiated_rate_usd,
       ROUND(p.discount_giveaway_pct * 100, 1) AS giveaway_pct,
       ROUND((p.net_service_rev_usd * p.discount_giveaway_pct) / 1e6, 2) AS giveaway_leakage_millions
FROM pricing_scenarios p
JOIN opportunities o ON p.opp_id = o.opp_id
WHERE p.discount_giveaway_pct >= 0.15
ORDER BY giveaway_leakage_millions DESC;
questions.sample_tools_yaml:

questions.tier_name: Tier 2 (30%): Semantic Layer (Dataplex KC DAX Formulas) + Pre-Computed Gold Views + Counterfactual Simulator
questions.domain_group: Sold Margin vs. Delivered EAC Variance
questions.question: Which accounts exhibit the largest negative gap between Sold Margin in Deal_Pricing_Engine and actual Delivered EAC Margin in Delivery_Governance_Hub?
questions.db_only_verdict: PARTIAL - Requires Semantic DAX + Gold View
questions.diagnosis: Pre-sales opportunity IDs and post-sales ERP project codes use disparate composite keys across systems; requires pre-joined entity resolution in `v_gold_account_360_health`.
questions.recommended_architecture: Query `v_gold_account_360_health` via MCP Toolbox `get_account_360_composite_health`.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT o.account_id, o.account_name, d.rag_status,
       ROUND(p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped * 100, 1) AS sold_adj_yield_pct,
       ROUND(d.eac_margin_variance_pct * 100, 1) AS eac_variance_pct,
       d.sla_slippage_days,
       ROUND(ABS(d.eac_margin_variance_pct) * p.net_service_rev_usd / 1e6, 2) AS margin_erosion_millions
FROM opportunities o
JOIN pricing_scenarios p ON o.opp_id = p.opp_id
JOIN delivery_health d ON o.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.eac_margin_variance_pct < 0
ORDER BY d.eac_margin_variance_pct ASC;

questions.tier_name: Tier 2 (30%): Semantic Layer (Dataplex KC DAX Formulas) + Pre-Computed Gold Views + Counterfactual Simulator
questions.question: Simulate the margin impact of shifting 15% of onshore principal hours to nearshore AI-augmented delivery pods across all Stage 3 and Stage 4 opportunities.
questions.diagnosis: Requires dynamic cost-rate substitution in the pricing model rather than static table retrieval.
questions.recommended_architecture: Invoke the Tier-2 Python Counterfactual Simulator over `pricing_scenarios`.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT o.opp_id, o.account_name, o.stage_name,
       ROUND(p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped * 100, 1) AS current_yield_pct,
       ROUND((p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped + 0.032) * 100, 1) AS pyramid_shifted_yield_pct,
       ROUND(p.net_service_rev_usd * 0.032 / 1e6, 2) AS incremental_margin_millions
FROM opportunities o
JOIN pricing_scenarios p ON o.opp_id = p.opp_id
WHERE o.stage_name LIKE 'Stage 3%' OR o.stage_name LIKE 'Stage 4%'
ORDER BY incremental_margin_millions DESC;

questions.tier_name: Tier 3 (49%): Federated Multi-Tool Agent (Structured SQL + Unstructured CLM/Visit RAG + External Market Intelligence APIs)
questions.question: Which top accounts show high 'AI Self-Sufficiency / Insourcing Risk' based on external ML engineering hiring telemetry (`Tech_Stack_Telemetry_Feed`) combined with executive visit debrief notes (`Customer_Visit_Logs`), and how much active TCV is exposed?
flags: Hidden Unstructured Notes in Tabular Source
questions.diagnosis: Internal CRM tables have zero visibility into a client's external ML job postings (`Tech_Stack_Telemetry_Feed`) or qualitative CTO statements in `Customer_Visit_Logs`.
questions.recommended_architecture: Federated ADK Agent: (1) Query `CRM_Opportunity_Spine` via MCP Toolbox, (2) Fetch external hiring telemetry from `Tech_Stack_Telemetry_Feed`, (3) Run semantic search over `Customer_Visit_Logs`.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT o.opp_id, o.account_name, ROUND(o.tcv_usd / 1e6, 2) AS tcv_m,
       m.ai_self_sufficiency_index, m.signal_summary,
       u.extracted_risk_tag, u.note_snippet
FROM opportunities o
JOIN external_market_signals m ON o.account_id = m.account_id
LEFT JOIN unstructured_deal_notes u ON o.opp_id = u.opp_id
WHERE m.ai_self_sufficiency_index >= 0.60
ORDER BY m.ai_self_sufficiency_index DESC;

questions.question: Cross-reference our active Stage 3-4 deals against executed MSAs in `CLM_Contract_Vault` to identify accounts where COLA inflation caps (<3%) or termination-for-convenience clauses threaten Adjusted Yield v4.
flags: Hidden Unstructured Notes in Tabular Source
questions.diagnosis: COLA caps, MFN clauses, and termination-for-convenience penalties live inside unstructured PDF contract clauses in `CLM_Contract_Vault`, not in structured ERP columns.
questions.recommended_architecture: Hybrid Retrieval: MCP Toolbox fetches deal margins from `Deal_Pricing_Engine` while Vertex AI RAG extracts legal clauses from `CLM_Contract_Vault`.
questions.sample_sql:
SELECT o.opp_id, o.account_name, o.stage_name,
       ROUND(o.tcv_usd / 1e6, 2) AS tcv_m,
       ROUND(p.adjusted_yield_v4_sigma_capped * 100, 1) AS adj_yield_pct,
       u.extracted_risk_tag, u.note_snippet
FROM opportunities o
JOIN pricing_scenarios p ON o.opp_id = p.opp_id
JOIN unstructured_deal_notes u ON o.opp_id = u.opp_id
WHERE u.source_system = 'CLM_Contract_Vault';
